channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Eduardo Galeano — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-30
item.description: “We are all mortal until the first kiss and the second glass of wine.” — Eduardo Galeano

item.title: Confucius — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-29
item.description: “Being in humaneness is good. If we select other goodness and thus are far apart from humaneness, how can we be the wise?” — Confucius

item.title: Anna Pavlova — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-28
item.description: “To follow, without halt, one aim: There is the secret of success.” — Anna Pavlova

item.title: Carl Jung — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-27
item.description: “One does not become enlightened by imagining figures of light, but by making the darkness conscious.” — Carl Jung

item.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-26
item.description: “Peace at home, peace in the world.” — Mustafa Kemal Atatürk

item.title: Sigmund Freud — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-25
item.description: “From error to error one discovers the entire truth.” — Sigmund Freud

item.title: Joe Paterno — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-24
item.description: “Believe deep down in your heart that you're destined to do great things.” — Joe Paterno

item.title: Rosa Parks — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-23
item.description: “I have learned over the years that when one's mind is made up, this diminishes fear; knowing what must be done does away with fear.” — Rosa Parks
